skills.description: Lamarckian skill evolution - continuously monitors every real skill invocation, drives governed evolution of the observed skills, and evolves itself by the same rules while running. A PostToolUse hook logs each invocation (stamped with the target skill's genome hash for per-version regression detection); a Stop hook runs a light evaluation loop whose protocol is embedded in the hook reason, so this SKILL.md is not reloaded every turn. Per-skill dynamic rubrics (git-versioned) define what "good" means for each skill; an evolution whitelist in config.json controls which skills may be edited (evolve/suggest/observe, default observe). Read this file only when escalating - when a skill accumulates enough same-type evidence to propose an edit, or on manual invocation. Use when the stop hook says to escalate, or when asked to review skill performance, optimize or improve a skill, audit the skill ledger, distill skill learnings, manage the evolution whitelist, or switch the lamarck trigger mode.

skills.description: Generates holiday consumption data report packages for any year and any Chinese holiday (Spring Festival, Dragon Boat, May Day, Summer Vacation, Mid-Autumn, National Day), at the NATIONAL (全国) dimension; city requests are handed off to the bundled `holiday-data-report-city` skill. National mode writes into a fixed `holiday-data-reports/` tree: the data side holds `data_set/{year}_{holiday}/` with `holiday-data-fetch.json` as SSOT plus `采集日志.csv` and on-demand `snapshots/`; the report side holds `data_report/{year}_{holiday}/` with `消费数据报告.html`, `数据真实性说明.html` and `index.html`. It uses a five-stage pipeline with a 22-field caliber dictionary and a continuity/forecast framework. When [地域] resolves to a concrete city, the bundled `holiday-data-report-city` skill adds city rows (30 fields: 22 national + 8 city) into that same SSOT, distinguished by the `地域粒度` field, reconciling (勾稽) every row to the national baseline. Before any collection, the skill resolves three parameters — [年份] (defaults to current year), [节日] (defaults to the festival of the current date), [地域] (defaults to 全国; a named city triggers city mode) — and proactively prompts the user when any cannot be derived. Collection is delegated to the holiday-data-fetch skill, which is **bundled inside this package** at `bundled/holiday-data-fetch/` so a standalone report install still runs. Stage one is a four-step D1-D4 pipeline: D1 probes **AtomGit** for half-match directories (year series + holiday series) and sparse-checks out only `holiday-data-fetch.json` + `采集日志.csv` (never `snapshots/`); D2 ensures fetch is installed (running a terminology self-check after any fresh install); D3 falls back to the bundled copy; D4 dispatches rounds — a full match means 3 incremental rounds with the baseline as history input, no full match means 5 web-search rounds. A hit never skips fetch, it only reduces rounds. Gated by the three contracts; this skill owns parameter resolution, analysis, and delivery. Use when the user requests a Chinese-holiday consumption/spending data report, nationally or for a specific city.

skills.description: A股多因子Alpha挖掘与选股建模。基于真实行情/估值/财务/分红数据构建63个候选因子，执行IC检验、分层回测、相关性去冗余、Lasso/逐步回归筛选、复合因子合成与Fama-French五因子归因，输出标准量化研究报告(Markdown)与因子数据表(Excel)。触发词：Alpha因子挖掘、多因子分析、多因子选股模型、因子有效性检验、IC检验、因子组合优化、Fama-French归因、AlphaMiner、量化选股。
skills.description_zh:
分析标的	中证500（147 只）
时间区间	2020-06-30 至 2026-08-31
调仓频率	月度（12 期/年）
样本数量	147 只股票 × 75 个时间周期（面板行数 10507）
数据字段	前复权行情 / PE_TTM·PB·PCF / 财务摘要(TTM重构) / 分红
无风险利率	2.00%（年化）
数据源	AkShare（新浪行情、百度估值、东财财务与分红）
### 策略适用场景

- **适用市场**：趋势市（入选因子含动量/技术类）。
- **调仓频率**：月度调仓，月均换手率需结合交易成本（万三至千一）评估净收益。
- **资金容量**：流动性因子（Amihud/换手率）入选时需注意，小市值高非流动性股票的容量受限。
- **组合方式**：建议作为 Alpha 信号叠加在指数增强或中性策略中，单独使用需控制行业与市值暴露。

### 风险提示

- ⚠️ **幸存者偏差**：股票池取的是「当前」指数成分股，历史回测天然剔除了已退市/被调出的标的，绝对收益会被系统性高估，请勿直接外推实盘收益。
- ⚠️ **样本选择偏差**：小样本（<100 只）时单次抽样结果不稳定，建议扩大 --limit 或多次换种子（--seed）交叉验证。
- ⚠️ **滚动交叉验证通过**：5 折中 80% 的样本外夏普为正，拼接后整体夏普 0.64、年化 19.64%、最大回撤 -43.17%。但仍限于同一段历史与同一批股票，建议换股票池 / 换区间再验一次。
- ⚠️ 所有结论基于历史数据，存在样本内过拟合风险；样本外表现可能显著衰减。
- ⚠️ 有效时间周期仅 75 期，若少于 60 期，IC 显著性检验功效有限。
- ⚠️ 未考虑交易成本、冲击成本、停牌、涨跌停无法成交等实盘约束，实际净收益会低于回测值。
- ⚠️ 财务数据已按披露截止日滞后处理，但不排除个别公司追溯重述导致的前视污染。
- ⚠️ 因子有效性存在周期性失效（风格切换、监管变化、极端行情），需持续监控 IC 衰减。
- ⚠️ 本报告不构成投资建议，据此操作风险自负。
- ⚠️ **收益主要来自风格押注而非选股 Alpha**：FF5 中 SMB（暴露 1.10，t=11.5）、HML（暴露 0.25，t=3.4） 高度显著，R²=0.87 说明收益绝大部分可由风格因子解释。剔除风格后 Alpha 仍显著（p=0.0009），说明除风格外还有一定选股贡献；但风格暴露仍主导波动与回撤，实盘需控制风格偏离。
skills.name: A股量化专家-AlphaMiner多因子挖掘
